labeled_by: Claude (the builder), from raw PR records with evidence independent of the connector: git log -L for the line's last writer, and final-code inspection for whether the requested change was made. Not a human expert; spot checks welcome.
guideline: Root review comment by a reviewer: suggestion_accepted if its concrete fix (suggestion block or 'suggested fix' code) is in the final code; correction if it requests a change and the requested change was made; rejection if it requests a change that was not made; a clarifying question after which the code there changed counts as a correction; approval for praise; none for questions answered without change and for discussion. Replies in threads and the author's own comments: none. Reviews: APPROVED -> approval, CHANGES_REQUESTED -> rejection, COMMENTED without a request -> none. CI runs: check_result. Grades: the PR commit that last wrote the commented line (git log -L at the comment's commit); null when the line predates the PR. Outcome: merged and 30+ days without revert or hotfix -> good; closed unmerged or reverted -> bad; otherwise unknown.
